reviewNotes: HOLD - AUA's official material describes a four-year MD with basic sciences in Antigua and clinical sciences at affiliated US teaching hospitals; the current published tuition structure and support options are available. CAAM-HP independently records Accreditation with Conditions for 2024-2028, and WDOMS records a current MD programme in English with the recognized-accreditation note. This pass is held because publishing requires route-specific international entry/fee/cost detail, clinical-placement terms and a target-market licensing package rather than broad eligibility claims.
